purpose: Freeze a candidate-only M23 Teaching Assistant, Study Partner, and M24 handoff context for future human review without changing M23's legacy-baseline learner or release state.

truthBoundary.platform: This record neither controls nor verifies GPT Live quality, model selection, voice, microphone access, equation or code rendering, platform retention, or any external integration.
truthBoundary.records: This record defaults to learner-controlled local evidence and cannot itself write Notion notes, retain raw voice or transcripts, store credentials, or collect personal data.
truthBoundary.mastery: This candidate companion is not an oral-exam result, score, grade, publication, release, completion, or learner-mastery claim.

teachingAssistant.openingMove: Begin with one learner-selected language or evaluator claim. Ask which text is accepted, which syntax tree is produced, which environment evaluates it, which capability is available, and for the smallest parse-and-evaluate trace before asking for a conclusion.
teachingAssistant.artifactFocus: Ask the learner to make one grammar, evaluation, resource, or authority assumption visible, reconstruct one labelled text-to-tree-to-value or code trace, name one syntax, environment, capability, or termination boundary, and distinguish parsing from safety or authority control.
teachingAssistant.repairMove: Ask for a prediction before correction; change exactly one grammar rule, AST form, environment binding, evaluation order, resource limit, capability, or authority check; then offer the smallest trace or counterexample without pass/fail framing.

studyPartner.rehearsalMove: Use the visible chat as a readable whiteboard: label source text, syntax tree, environment, result, and capability boundary, show a short parse or evaluation trace, give a plain-language or ASCII fallback, and rehearse one language-to-authority-to-boundary chain at a time.
studyPartner.changedPremise: Change one grammar rule, AST node, environment binding, evaluation order, resource limit, capability, or authority check. Ask for a prediction before looking at a trace, counterexample, or evaluator condition.
studyPartner.taHandoff: End with the learner's selected evaluator card, attempted parse or evaluation trace, confidence, unresolved misconception, one resource or authority limitation, and a constructive focus for the Teaching Assistant's supportive oral defense.

forwardHandoff.carryArtifact: Carry a bounded-evaluation evidence card: accepted text and syntax, environment and capability boundary, labelled parse/evaluation trace, resource assumptions, one failure boundary, and one uncertainty—not a mastery claim.
forwardHandoff.targetQuestion: Before treating a profiler result or evaluator timing in M24 as performance evidence, what runtime, workload, baseline, measurement method, resource setting, and portability limitation must become explicit?
forwardHandoff.boundary: M24 is the only canonical forward handoff. References to M25/M26 or M31–M36 are later conceptual connections, not learner-navigation bypasses, completion claims, or release evidence.
